question: The leaders of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) have endorsed the city of as ______ the first ever tourist and cultural capital of the grouping for the year 2022-23.
solution:
The correct answer is __Varanasi.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Varanasi will be the first city in Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) region to be granted the rotating title of ‘Cultural & Tourism capital of SCO’.
 
• It will become the Capital for 2022-23 under a new rotating initiative by the SCO to promote people-to-people contacts and tourism among the member states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) is a Eurasian political, economic and security alliance.
 
• In terms of geographic scope and population, it is the world's largest regional organization.
 
• It covers approximately 60% of the area of Eurasia, 40% of the world's population, and more than 30% of global GDP. 
 
• The SCO currently comprises eight Member States (China, India, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, Pakistan, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan).
 
• The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation:
 
 
• Headquarters: Beijing, China
 
• Founded: 15 June 2001
 
• Founders: Russia, China, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan​​
